description: Fix both architectural deviations from paper Fig. 2: (1) router reads T_i only (not T_comb), (2) router runs inside each MoEWrapper reading x[:,0:1,:] (image token position in per-layer hidden state) rather than broadcasting one gate_probs to all layers.
changes_from_run_002: router input: mean-pooled T_comb → T_i only (image_token from projector)
router placement: once before LLM (broadcast) → inside each MoEWrapper, reads x[:,0:1,:] per layer

model.router: Linear 576->4, reads T_i (projector output, pre-LLM) in Phase 2; reads x[:,0:1,:] per layer in Phase 3

moe.gate_source: per-layer router call on image token hidden state (eq. 4, paper Fig. 2)

losses.phase2: L_Instr (LM CE) + L_Router (CE over domain labels)

phase2.note: Router learned successfully — 25% (random) → 81% accuracy. Key fix: router now reads T_i (pure image signal from projector) instead of mean-pooled T_comb which mixed in LLM text embeddings and swamped the domain signal.

phase3.note: Slightly higher final loss than run_002 (1.035 vs 0.879), expected — per-layer routing introduces more variance per step as each of 30 layers calls the router independently on its hidden state.

inference.routing_behavior: Per-layer routing is now domain-sensitive and evolves across depth. MRI: early layers use E0/E3, layers 17-27 shift to E2 (MRI expert). CT: E1 (CT) appears at layers 5,25,27. X-Ray: E0 dominant throughout. Gate probs range 0.19-0.31 (vs perfectly uniform 0.25 in run_002).
